dashboard.label: TA-throttle Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype throttle:metrics); series prefixed 'throttle.'.

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-throttle requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-throttle", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-throttle/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms
| mstats avg("throttle.freq_*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "throttle.freq_*"
| mstats avg("throttle.*count") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "throttle.*count"

panel.title: New throttle events since last cycle (per package + global)

search.query: | mstats avg("throttle.*new") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "throttle.*new"
